mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix fact allows arbitrary role-to-operation assignments, which violates the flat peer model where all authenticated members must have equal permissions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ArbitraryPermissions { some r: Role, op: OperationKind | (r -> op) not in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the authentication requirement fact allows tasks to exist without a creator, which violates FR-001 that every request must be authenticated.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuthRequired { some t: Task | no t.creator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the assignee constraint allows tasks to be assigned to non-existent members, violating FR-008 that assignees must be current workspace members.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidAssignee { some t: Task, m: Member | (t.assignee = m and m not in Member) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the status constraint allows tasks to have invalid status values outside {todo, in_progress, done}, violating FR-010.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidStatus { some t: Task | t.status not in (TODO + IN_PROGRESS + DONE) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the title constraint allows tasks to exist without a title, violating FR-005 that requires a non-empty title.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoTitle { some t: Task | no t.title }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only constraint on TaskDeletion allows deletion log entries to be mutated or corrupted, violating the immutability guarantee for operational logs in FR-018.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MutableLog { some td: TaskDeletion | no td.task_title_at_delete }
